title: Exponent-uniform product-set growth in sufficiently large odd Burnside quotients of a torsion-free hyperbolic group
difficulty_reason: H2: the existing acylindrical extraction theorem does not apply directly to the final periodic group. The author supplies quantitative finite-quotient acylindricity control by treating sets fixing a cone apex and those lifting away from all apices, and bounds energy when lifting to the previous stage. These estimates keep the required constants fixed along the small-cancellation tower. The final proof chooses the first stage admitting a low-energy lift, moves back to the controlled energy window, invokes the independently retained aperiodic/power-free counting, and uses the source-declared uniform non-triviality criterion to pass to the periodic quotient before the exact-product parity closure. This parameter-propagation and energy-selection mechanism is an independent nonroutine H2 burden. Imported induction theory and the source-sketched detection criterion are explicit dependencies, not assistant-completed proofs or additional counts.

editorial_notes: Exact author statement, full proof and complete work context retained; no assistant proof or corrected formula, added assumption or correctness certificate.

Existing2093 is exactly Theorem8.1 for an(N,kappa)-acylindrical action on a delta-hyperbolic length space, with its energy and cardinality alternatives. Reuse its concrete historical H2 judgment and complete original author framework; do not regrade it or add new conclusions to that stable ID.

For3.11 U is a finite alpha-strongly-reduced alphabet at the fixed basepoint p, with at least two elements, in the exact source ambient-action setting. Lambda=max_u|up-p| is a fixed-basepoint displacement bound, whereas lambda(U)=inf_x max_u|ux-x| is the later energy; they are not interchangeable.

U* is the free monoid on U, B(r) is its word-length ball, and U*_m excludes geometric m-period subwords relative to maximal loxodromic subgroups. The source permits real m; an m-period is not the same object as a geometric m-power or a literal algebraic power. Strong reduction provides the stated injectivity into G.

The3.11 threshold m1 has the exact source parameter dependence(lambda,alpha,A,nu,tau,delta), and the cardinality factor is |U|/2. Preserve r>0 as stated and the proof's integer induction as written; do not add a stronger asymptotic rate or a new uniformity claim outside the given parameters.

Theorem1.2 fixes a non-cyclic torsion-free hyperbolic group G. There exist n0,c>0 depending only on G so that every odd n>=n0 and every finite V subset G/G^n satisfy the finite-cyclic alternative or the exact-product lower bound for all natural r. V need not be symmetric or contain the identity; V^r means exactly r factors, not a word ball.

The quotient is by the subgroup generated by all n-th powers, and the exponent in the cardinality estimate is floor((r+1)/2). Do not change odd to even, remove torsion-freeness, strengthen to a free-subgroup claim in the periodic quotient, or import the identity assumption from entropyCorollary1.3.

The approximating tower keeps n1,N,A0,delta1,rho0,L0 and the chosen rescaling epsilon_(n1) fixed before varying n and the tower index. The minimum-index lift has energy100A0<lambda(U_(j-1))<=lambda0. Preserve the maximum defining M and the uniform c=1/M, and m=n/2-xi without an editor's integer rounding.

Finite-quotient acylindricity Proposition9.9 and energy lift9.13 have complete author arguments and supply the new control used in the uniform-tower unit. Their original cyclic-elementary-subgroup/cone-off and small-cancellation hypotheses remain in the complete source. They are not separately counted again as additional units of this same parameter-propagation mechanism.

Proposition10.1 is an adapted induction result with details explicitly referred to Coulon2014; the author adds the acylindricity/energy estimates. Theorem10.3 is quoted from Coulon2018; Theorem10.4 has a source-declared Sketch of proof adapting that work. Retain all statements and provided text as named dependencies; neither is registered as a complete new standalone proof and no missing induction/detection proof is supplied.

The selected main-theorem unit contains the author's complete final parameter/lifting/growth argument after those explicit dependencies. It is not described as a self-contained proof of every imported or source-sketched ingredient. EntropyCorollary1.3 and the even-exponent discussion retain their original roles and create no new primary.

Existing2093 and the independent3.11 counting unit are shared inputs. Preserve full8.3 and Proposition10.1 statements, quotedTheorem10.3 and sourceSketchTheorem10.4 as context/dependencies. Do not claim a self-contained completion of their referred or sketched proofs, or change the literal m-power/m-power-free wording.
